lines: i stole
the pic-i-nic basket
AM I THE ONLY ONE WHO UPVOTES MEMES
JUST FOR MORE IMGFLIP POINTS?
IT'S 2017 AND MY CELLPHONE HAS MORE COMPUTING POWER THAN NASA HAD IN 1969
THEY SENT A MAN TO THE MOON. I MADE THIS MEME
MY WIFE KEEPS COMPLAINING THAT I DON'T DO ENOUGH WORK AROUND THE HOUSE
IT'S LIKE SHE THINKS THIS IMGFLIP ACCOUNT RUNS ITSELF
MY SPOUSE FROM SWITZERLAND IS IN THE MILITARY. SHE'S MY SWISS ARMY WIFE.
Got a job at Comcast and completed training so I could fix my own cable
because it was faster than being on hold with customer service.
AFTER OPENING THIS MONTH'S ELECTRIC BILL I'M NO LONGER SCARED OF THE DARK
SOMETIMES I PUSH MY HAND OUT AT THOSE AUTOMATIC DOORS TO ACT LIKE I HAVE THE FORCE
I WISH MY GRASS WAS EMO SO IT WOULD CUT ITSELF
I ONCE DATED A GIRL WITH A PARROT. IT WAS CRAZY AND NEVER SHUT UP
THE PARROT WAS COOL THOUGH
Right before I die, I`m going to swallow a bag of popcorn kernels
to make the cremation a bit more interesting
YOU KNOW WHO I THINK IS GOING TO LOSE THIS YEAR'S ELECTION? AMERICA
WHEN I DIE, I WANT MY GRAVE TO HAVE FREE WIFI
THAT WAY PEOPLE WILL COME VISIT MORE OFTEN
I WISH I COULD BE UGLY FOR JUST ONE DAY. BECAUSE BEING UGLY EVERY DAY KINDA SUCKS.
SOMETIMES I UPVOTE MEMES I DON'T REALLY LIKE
BUT BECAUSE I THINK THE PERSON IS COOL AND MADE A GOOD EFFORT I UPVOTE IT ANYWAYS
I'M REALLY AFRAID SOMEONE IS GOING TO WIN THIS ELECTION
I BOUGHT MY SON LEGOS FOR HIS BIRTHDAY TOMORROW
AND A PAIR OF STEEL TOED SLIPPERS FOR ME
MY BOSS TOLD ME TO HAVE A GOOD DAY
SO I WENT HOME
MY CO-WORKERS ARE JUST LIKE FAMILY TO ME
I DON'T LIKE SPENDING TIME WITH THEM EITHER
MY NEIGHBORS ARE BLASTING TEJANO MUSIC WITH THEIR NEW HOME THEATER SYSTEM
TURNS OUT IT IS BLUETOOTH SO I JUST CONNECTED TO IT FROM MY PHONE AND RICK ROLLED THEM

meaning.meaning_en: This meme features a bear with a guilty, sheepish expression, typically used to confess a minor wrongdoing, a silly secret, or a relatable embarrassing habit. The top text usually states the 'confession' or the action taken, while the bottom text (often left blank) provides a brief, often humorous justification or a punchline that explains the context of the guilt.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme zeigt einen Bären mit einem schuldigen, schüchternen Gesichtsausdruck und wird typischerweise verwendet, um ein kleines Vergehen, ein altes Geheimnis oder eine peinliche Gewohnheit zu gestehen. Der obere Text enthält meist das 'Geständnis' oder die Tat, während der untere Text (oft leer gelassen) eine kurze, humorvolle Rechtfertigung oder einen Pointe liefert.
situations_en: I deleted the group chat history
